text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I mean, yeah, I did say I welcome 
the pressure, but still~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Isn't choosing this race a little crazy? I 
mean, this race is—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And here they are, the Umamusume running 
today. Mejiro Ryan. And though frail, 
running with resolute grace, the 
glass-hearted lady, Mejiro Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume representing the Mejiro family. 
And today, there are other noteworthy 
Umamusume to keep an eye on as well.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, that star horse girl who defined an 
entire era!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap! It's Oguri Cap! She's been in 
an uncharacteristic slump over her last 
few races, but what kind of performance 
will she show us today!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Please, we're begging you, Oguri... Our 
idol...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Please, don't push yourself any harder... 
Just get some proper rest, okay...?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Yikes... What is this? A total mess of 
MAX expectation and MAX sympathy~)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Carrying feelings this heavy, how am I 
supposed to race?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, did you smile...? Were you smiling 
just now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
What kind of vibe did you even get from 
that? I don't get it at all, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's see it. The running of an 
Umamusume who's stayed at the top all this 
time!
